description: This file defines an in-memory pub-sub broker for order status events, allowing subscription, unsubscription, and publishing updates for specific order IDs in a food delivery backend system.

classes.name: OrderEventBroker
classes.description: An in-memory publish-subscribe broker managing order status events per order ID, supporting subscription and event publishing.

methods.name: None __init__(self)
methods.description: Initializes the broker with a default dictionary of queues and an asyncio lock.

methods.name: asyncio.Queue[dict[str,Any]] subscribe(self, order_id: int)
methods.description: Subscribes to order status events for a specific order ID, returning an asyncio queue with a maximum size of 100.

methods.name: None unsubscribe(self, order_id: int, q: asyncio.Queue[dict[str, Any]])
methods.description: Unsubscribes a given queue from receiving updates for a specific order ID.

methods.name: None publish_status(self, order_id: int, status: str)
methods.description: Publishes an order status event for a specific order ID to all subscribed queues.

ctags.name: publish_status
ctags.pattern: /^    async def publish_status(self, order_id: int, status: str) -> None:$/

ctags.name: subscribe
ctags.pattern: /^    async def subscribe(self, order_id: int) -> asyncio.Queue[dict[str, Any]]:$/

ctags.name: unsubscribe
ctags.pattern: /^    async def unsubscribe(self, order_id: int, q: asyncio.Queue[dict[str, Any]]) -> None:$/
